meta.title: Lead: Remaining institutional funding, founders, and support details for Iustitia, Themis, and Dom Sędziego Seniora
meta.notes: Concrete grant amounts and organisational details from Batory/Active Citizens (EEA/Norway), MEN, official foundation pages, and historical sources. Asset declarations for Markiewicz/Taborowski/Dziurda and full Themis annual financials remain unpublished in open sources examined. No direct USAID/NED grants to these associations identified beyond intermediaries.
